scope: Seven exact prompts/seeds/caps, one serial full diagnostic model load. This is a planning scenario for P6 attention bfp8_lofi + down bfp8_lofi; no P6 speed or output behavior measured.
range_assumptions: Low end allows a modest decode improvement from down HiFi2 to LoFi while retaining one load and output lengths near P4.

High end allows materially slower attention from BFP8 weight traffic plus longer sampled outputs; the P4 same-rate cap-fill sensitivity is 647.9s, then the envelope allows further policy/load/output variation.
P4 cap-fill estimate is not an upper bound for P6; different policy can alter weights, compute, prefill/decode, and output lengths.
P4 seven-case run is the sole quantitative timing anchor; P5 outputs/triage are intentionally not used as timing evidence while root review is pending.
decision_note: Root should review P5 terminal output/triage and stage deadline before deciding whether a P6 run is worth the time. This is not an admission or launch.
